note: G0: macOS desktop tasks through the Accessibility API. Calculator and TextEdit tasks change only Calculator's display and dedicated files under ~/.kage/g0/; System Settings tasks are read-only (no press/fill tools, except sidebar navigation in set_nav_tint). Every task has a trusted checker that reads the app or the file itself; the model's own claims never count. split=train: the original 10 (the baseline; failures there are shown to the teacher); split=test: unseen variants of the learnable families, used to check whether a lesson transfers.
